Board Meetings

The CalPERS Board of Administration and its committees meet each month at the CalPERS Headquarters, unless otherwise indicated. Board meetings are open to the public and broadcast live via webcast during open sessions. Board meeting videos can be accessed on our YouTube page. Closed sessions, which are not open to the public, will be indicated on the agenda.

We welcome public comment on agenda items presented to the board. If you have any questions or need to request special accommodations, contact the CalPERS Board Services Unit at (916) 795-3202.

Members of the public may provide public comment via telephone during the board meeting by calling (800) 259-4105. All public comments shall be subject to CalPERS Public Comment Regulation (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 2, § 552.1.). We will not be accepting public comment via email.

Board and committee meeting attendance is available in the transcripts and meeting minutes. Additionally, this information is compiled in an annual board attendance report:

  • 2025 Board Attendance Report (PDF)
  • 2024 Board Attendance Report (PDF)

The next CalPERS Board meeting is November 16-18, 2026. Review the September 4, 2026 Board meeting notice (PDF) and September 8, 2026 Amended Board meeting notice (PDF).

  • September 14
    • Board of Administration (Closed Session)
    • Investment Committee
  • September 15
    • Performance, Compensation & Talent Management Committee
    • Pension & Health Benefits Committee
    • Finance & Administration Committee
  • September 16
    • Risk & Audit Committee
    • Board of Administration

The board meeting notice is available 10 days prior to the first board meetings and includes agendas for all three days. Notices, agendas, and agenda items for the current year and past two years are available.
